records.source: Oh, hi.
records.translation: 喔，嗨。

records.source: Oh, that's right... I heard someone new was moving onto that old farm.#$e#It's kind of a shame, really. I always enjoyed exploring those overgrown fields by myself.$9
records.translation: 喔，對了……我聽說有人要搬進那座舊農場。#$e#其實有點可惜。我一直很喜歡獨自探索那些雜草叢生的田野。$9

records.source: Hey, sure. Let's do it. We can be embarrassed together.$h
records.translation: 嘿，好啊。一起跳吧。我們可以一起出糗。$h

records.source: Hey, you remembered my birthday... Thanks, @! This is really nice!$h
records.translation: 嘿，你記得我的生日……謝謝你，@！這真不錯！$h

records.source: Hey, you remembered my birthday... Thanks, @!$h#$b#Oh, it's, uh... *sniff*... what is it?$s
records.translation: 嘿，你記得我的生日……謝謝你，@！$h#$b#喔，這是，呃……*嗅嗅*……這是什麼？$s

records.source: Wow... the color is so beautiful, like an amethyst. Thanks!
records.translation: 哇……顏色真美，像紫水晶一樣。謝啦！

records.source: Disgusting... I love it!$h
records.translation: 真噁心……我好喜歡！$h

records.source: Hey, this is my favorite magazine! My Dad won't let me have a subscription, so I have to get it on the black market like this...$h
records.translation: 嘿，這是我最喜歡的雜誌！爸爸不准我訂閱，所以只能像這樣從黑市弄到手……$h

records.source: Whoa, that's a creepy looking book... I love it!#$b#*Flip* *flip* *flip*... Ooh... It's full of monsters...$h#$b#I'll have to study this before going into the caves... Thanks!
records.translation: 哇，那本書看起來陰森森的……我好喜歡！#$b#*翻頁* *翻頁* *翻頁*……喔……裡面全是怪物……$h#$b#進洞穴前得好好研究這本書……謝啦！

records.source: Whoa... Where'd you find this? The workmanship is fascinating...#$b#It's a little too rusty to use, but I'll add it to my collection.
records.translation: 哇……你在哪裡找到的？工藝真迷人……#$b#雖然鏽得太厲害，不能使用，但我會把它加入收藏。

records.source: This makes you wonder... Thousands of years ago, there was probably a little purple-haired cavewoman who played this flute, just like me.#$b#...I'll have to wash it before pressing it to my lips, though.$h
records.translation: 這讓人忍不住想……幾千年前，也許有位和我一樣的紫髮小穴居女孩吹過這支笛子。#$b#……不過在把它湊到嘴邊前，得先洗乾淨。$h

records.source: $c 0.5#Wow... it's just my color! Thanks, @!$h#Thank you! This is my favorite stone. It's so pretty.
records.translation: $c 0.5#哇……正是適合我的顏色！謝謝你，@！$h#謝謝你！這是我最喜歡的寶石。真漂亮。

records.source: I want to go exploring, but I can tell my Mom is kind of worried. I don't want to add to her stress.
records.translation: 我想出去探索，但看得出媽媽有點擔心。我不想再增加她的壓力。

records.source: And just like that, everything's back to normal. It's like magic!$h
records.translation: 就這麼一下子，一切都恢復正常了。簡直像魔法！$h

records.source: Have you seen all the crazy trees around town? Everything looks so different... I feel like we're in a fairy world.
records.translation: 你看到鎮上那些瘋狂生長的樹了嗎？一切看起來都截然不同……感覺像來到了精靈世界。

records.source: Don't tell anyone, but I snuck into the old community center last night... I think it's haunted!
records.translation: 別告訴任何人，但我昨晚偷偷溜進了舊社區中心……那裡好像鬧鬼！

records.source: Oh, wow... @! Are you sure you want to give this to me? It's so rare!#$b#I'll admit, my mouth is watering already...$h
records.translation: 喔，哇……@！你確定要把這個送給我嗎？它非常稀有！#$b#我承認，已經開始流口水了……$h

records.source: I heard you've been exploring the old mines. That sounds like fun!$h#$e#...I'm working up the courage to go there myself...$s
records.translation: 我聽說你一直在探索舊礦井。聽起來很好玩！$h#$e#……我正在鼓起勇氣，準備親自去看看……$s

records.source: Sam and Sebastian asked me to play drums in their band... I've never played drums before, but it's actually pretty fun.#$e#You have to learn how to move your limbs to different rhythms, at the same exact time. I feel like my brain is growing.$h
records.translation: 山姆和賽巴斯汀邀請我在他們的樂團打鼓……我以前從沒打過鼓，但其實很好玩。#$e#你得學會讓四肢同時跟著不同的節奏動起來。感覺大腦都在成長。$h

records.source: Hey, I finally beat the first level of Journey Of The Prairie King! Watching you play helped a lot.
records.translation: 嘿，我終於打通《草原王之旅》的第一關了！看你遊玩幫了很大的忙。

records.source: Sebastian mentioned that he heard strange music while having dinner the other night...#$e#I didn't tell him it was us! It seemed better to keep it a mystery.$h
records.translation: 賽巴斯汀提到前幾天吃晚餐時聽見奇怪的音樂……#$e#我沒告訴他那是我們！讓它保持神祕似乎更好。$h

records.source: The spirits have a mind of their own...$l
records.translation: 那些靈魂有自己的想法……$l

records.source: Feeling pretty good about the egg hunt, huh? Well, next year you won't be so lucky...$u
records.translation: 贏了找彩蛋活動，感覺很好吧？嗯，明年可不會這麼走運了……$u

records.source: I'm still mad that you beat me at the egg hunt last year. You'd better start practicing...
records.translation: 我還在氣你去年找彩蛋贏過我。最好開始練習了……

records.source: %Abigail is blushing, but she looks happy.
records.translation: %Abigail臉紅了，但看起來很開心。

records.source: ...You're cute.$l
records.translation: ……你真可愛。$l

records.source: Uh... @? We've been dating for almost a year. Is this going anywhere?$s
records.translation: 呃……@？我們交往快一年了。這段關係會有結果嗎？$s

records.source: I heard you and Sebastian started dating... I didn't realize you guys had a thing...$6
records.translation: 我聽說你和賽巴斯汀開始交往了……沒想到你們彼此有意思……$6

records.source: Hey, I heard you and Sam got together... He's a really good guy!$h#$e#We've been friends for a long time. You'd better be good to him, or you'll see my bad side!
records.translation: 嘿，我聽說你和山姆在一起了……他真的是個好人！$h#$e#我們做朋友很久了。你最好好好對他，不然會見識到我不好惹的一面！

records.source: Congratulations on the marriage. I guess this means Sebastian won't be moving to the city like he always talked about.$6#$b#That'll be nice. I'd be kind of sad if I never saw him again. We've always been good friends.$6
records.translation: 恭喜你們結婚。看來賽巴斯汀不會像他一直說的那樣搬去城市了。$6#$b#這樣很好。如果再也見不到他，我會有點難過。我們一直都是好朋友。$6

records.source: Haha... I can't believe Sam is a married man, now. Who would've thought?$h#$e#Joking aside, I think he'll make a great father some day.
records.translation: 哈哈……真不敢相信山姆現在是已婚男人了。誰想得到？$h#$e#說正經的，我覺得他有一天會成為很棒的父親。

records.source: Did you hear about the new movie theater in town? I'm excited to check it out!$h
records.translation: 你聽說鎮上新開的電影院了嗎？我迫不及待想去看看！$h

records.source: I hope a mermaid visits the beach.
records.translation: 希望會有美人魚來到海灘。

records.source: I'm gonna ask Willy if we can take the scenic route back.
records.translation: 我要問問威利，回程能不能走風景優美的航線。

records.source: Maybe we'll see a sea monster on the way back.
records.translation: 也許回程會看到海怪。

records.source: The beach is okay, but it gets boring pretty quick. I'd rather check out that dark jungle, or the volcano!
records.translation: 海灘還行，但很快就會無聊。我寧願去看看那片黑暗的叢林，或是火山！

records.source: Hmm, you think I could sneak my guinea pig onto the island?#$e#Nah, David's probably not much of a swimmer anyways.$h
records.translation: 嗯，你覺得我能偷偷把天竺鼠帶上島嗎？#$e#算了，反正大衛大概也不太會游泳。$h

records.source: My skin gets burnt really easily. So I'm just gonna stay under this umbrella for a while.#$e#I like it in the shade. Too much sun makes me dizzy.
records.translation: 我的皮膚很容易曬傷。所以要在這把陽傘下待一陣子。#$e#我喜歡陰影。太多陽光會讓我頭暈。

records.source: Hey @, want to build a sand castle with me?#$e#Actually, a sand dungeon might be cooler!$h
records.translation: 嘿，@，想和我一起蓋沙堡嗎？#$e#其實，沙地牢可能更酷！$h

records.source: Hey @, you think you could build a raft?#$e#I saw a few cool islands on the way here I want to visit.
records.translation: 嘿，@，你覺得自己能造艘木筏嗎？#$e#來的路上，我看到幾座很酷的島嶼，很想去看看。

records.source: An island this big has got to be hiding some buried treasure.#$e#Quick, get me a shovel!#$e#Relax, I'm just kidding.$h
records.translation: 這麼大的島一定藏著埋在地下的寶藏。#$e#快，拿把鏟子給我！#$e#放輕鬆，我只是開玩笑。$h

records.source: Gus made me a dark purple refresher, to match my hair. It tastes great!$h
records.translation: 格斯替我調了一杯深紫色的清涼飲料，和頭髮相配。味道很棒！$h

records.source: Bummer... Willy says we have to stay on the beach...$s#$b#And I brought my sword and everything...$s
records.translation: 真掃興……威利說我們必須待在海灘上……$s#$b#我明明連劍都帶來了……$s

records.source: B... But... I wanted to dance with...$s#$b#Just kidding! Of course I'm dancing with you. I love you.$h
records.translation: 可、可是……我本來想和……$s#$b#開玩笑的！當然要和你跳舞。我愛你。$h

records.source: That's flattering... but I'm gonna have to say no. Sorry.
records.translation: 你這麼邀請我，我很榮幸……但必須拒絕。抱歉。

records.source: What are you doing here? Just leave me alone!$a
records.translation: 你來這裡做什麼？別來煩我！$a

records.source: Don't talk to me!$a
records.translation: 別和我說話！$a

records.source: *sigh*... I can't stay mad at you anymore, @. Let's just move on with our lives.$s
records.translation: *嘆氣*……我沒辦法再繼續生你的氣了，@。讓我們放下這件事，繼續生活吧。$s

records.source: Oh... I... I understand. You see me as just a friend...$s#$b#I guess we weren't really a good match...$s
records.translation: 喔……我……我明白。你只把我當朋友……$s#$b#看來我們真的不太合適……$s

records.source: Oh, hey. Taking a break from work?
records.translation: 喔，嘿。工作告一段落，休息一下嗎？

records.source: Oh, hi!#$e#Do you ever hang out at the cemetery? It's a peaceful place to spend some time alone.
records.translation: 喔，嗨！#$e#你會去墓園待著嗎？那裡很安靜，適合獨處一會兒。

records.source: Ugh... I'm not in a good mood right now.$s#$e#I said I'm not in a good mood... what do you want?$a
records.translation: 呃……我現在心情不好。$s#$e#都說了我心情不好……你想幹嘛？$a

records.source: ...*sigh*...$s#$e#I know my parents mean well, but sometimes they just cannot understand my point of view. Weren't they ever young?
records.translation: ……*嘆氣*……$s#$e#我知道爸媽是出於好意，但有時他們就是無法理解我的觀點。他們難道沒有年輕過嗎？

records.source: Hey. Sorry in advance if I say anything rude. I didn't get much sleep last night.#$e#What do you want?
records.translation: 嘿。如果我說了什麼無禮的話，先道歉。昨晚沒睡好。#$e#你想幹嘛？

records.source: #$1 Abigail1#Oh no, I think my Dad's going to cook dinner tonight...$s#$e#I don't feel like doing anything today...$u
records.translation: #$1 Abigail1#糟了，今晚好像是爸爸做晚餐……$s#$e#我今天什麼也不想做……$u

records.source: Wow, I just realized it's Friday. $u#$e#Sometimes I totally lose track of time.
records.translation: 哇，我剛發現今天是星期五。$u#$e#有時我完全感覺不到時間流逝。

records.source: We're all going to hang out in the saloon this evening. It's kind of like a Friday tradition, I guess.
records.translation: 今晚我們都要去酒館一起玩。這大概算是星期五的傳統。

records.source: The fresh mountain air is nice on a day like this.$h#$e#I wonder if the frogs will make an appearance soon.
records.translation: 這種日子裡，山上的新鮮空氣真舒服。$h#$e#不知道青蛙是否很快就會現身。

records.source: Oh man... I've been pushing off my homework all weekend. Looks like I'll be pulling another all-nighter...$s
records.translation: 天啊……整個週末我都在拖延作業。看來又得熬夜了……$s

records.source: I wonder what would happen if I spent all night in the graveyard?#$q 17/18 Sun_old#@, what do you think happens to us after we die?#$r 17 0 Sun_17#I have no idea.#$r 18 40 Sun_18#We come back as spooky ghosts.#$r 17 0 Sun_17#We go to Heaven.#$r 18 0 Sun_17#Our energy bodies enter the astral plane.#$r 17 30 Sun_nothing#Nothing. We just cease to exist.
records.translation: 不知道如果整晚待在墓地，會發生什麼事？#$q 17/18 Sun_old#@，你覺得人死後會怎樣？#$r 17 0 Sun_17#我不知道。#$r 18 40 Sun_18#我們會化作嚇人的幽靈回來。#$r 17 0 Sun_17#我們會上天堂。#$r 18 0 Sun_17#我們的能量體會進入星光界。#$r 17 30 Sun_nothing#什麼也不會發生。我們就此不復存在。

records.source: $p 17#I guess you think nothing would happen, right?$u|Maybe a wicked ghost would appear!
records.translation: $p 17#我猜你覺得什麼也不會發生，對吧？$u|也許會出現邪惡的幽靈！

records.source: Hmm, interesting...
records.translation: 嗯，很有意思……

records.source: Well that's an interesting theory!$h
records.translation: 嗯，這個理論很有意思！$h

records.source: You know, that wouldn't be so bad.$8
records.translation: 你知道嗎，那樣也不算太糟。$8

records.source: Oh, hi @. Taking a break from your work?#$e#Me too. Oh! Nothing physical... just some online classes I'm taking.
records.translation: 喔，嗨，@。工作告一段落，休息一下嗎？#$e#我也是。喔！不是體力活……只是正在上的幾門線上課程。

records.source: Hi, I'm glad to see you.$h#$e#I want to take my mind off things for a while... how is your day going?
records.translation: 嗨，很高興見到你。$h#$e#我想暫時不去想那些事……你今天過得如何？

records.source: You came all this way to visit me? That's nice.$h#$e#So have you been exploring the mountain caves at all?#$e#Interesting. I'd like to go there myself one of these days.$l
records.translation: 你特地跑這麼遠來看我？真好。$h#$e#所以，你有探索過山裡的洞穴嗎？#$e#有意思。我也想找一天親自去看看。$l

records.source: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#I remember when you first arrived in town, I was a little sad that those old woods would be turned into farmland. But now I'm really glad you moved here!$h|...Oh, @! Hi.$h#$e#Want to hang out for a while? Here! Let me read your palm. *giggle*$h
records.translation: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#我記得你剛來到鎮上時，想到那片老樹林會變成農田，還有點難過。但現在真的很高興你搬來了！$h|……喔，@！嗨。$h#$e#想一起待一會兒嗎？來！讓我替你看手相。*咯咯笑*$h

records.source: Hi.$l#$e#Do you feel like everything seems unreal lately?$l#$b#Not in a bad way, though.$h
records.translation: 嗨。$l#$e#你有沒有覺得最近一切都很不真實？$l#$b#不過不是壞的那種。$h

records.source: The birds were happily chirping today. They're too simple to understand the future.#$e#It's better to be like them, isn't it?
records.translation: 鳥兒今天開心地啁啾著。牠們太單純，不會理解未來。#$e#像牠們一樣反而更好，對吧？

records.source: Great! I'm sure you'll be able to beat this level with ease.$h
records.translation: 太好了！你一定能輕鬆打通這一關。$h

records.source: Oh? *sigh*... I guess I'll never get past this level, then...$s
records.translation: 喔？*嘆氣*……那我大概永遠過不了這一關了……$s

records.source: See? You understand why I'm out here, then.#$b#I've lived in the valley my whole life, but I've never really done anything memorable. I want to go on an adventure!$8
records.translation: 看吧？那你就明白我為什麼待在外面了。#$b#我一輩子都住在山谷裡，卻從沒真正做過值得銘記的事。我想去冒險！$8

records.source: Sure. I don't want to kill anything, either. I just want to do a little exploring without risking my neck!#$b#I've lived in the valley my whole life, but I've never really done anything memorable. I want to go on an adventure!$8
records.translation: 當然。我也不想殺害任何東西。只想稍微探索一下，又不用拿命冒險！#$b#我一輩子都住在山谷裡，卻從沒真正做過值得銘記的事。我想去冒險！$8

records.source: Oh, it's because I'm a girl... isn't it? Ugh...$u^Why? I'm just as strong as you!$a#$b#I'm not some fragile princess.. I can take care of myself!$a#$b#I've lived in the valley my whole life, but I've never really done anything memorable. I want to go on an adventure!$8
records.translation: 喔，是因為我是女生……對吧？呃……$u^為什麼？我和你一樣強壯！$a#$b#我不是什麼脆弱的公主……我能照顧自己！$a#$b#我一輩子都住在山谷裡，卻從沒真正做過值得銘記的事。我想去冒險！$8
